result.title: Health checkup results
result.emptyTitle: No health checkup result to show
result.emptyDescription: Import your results to see the values and date here.
result.listEmpty:
You haven’t imported any health checkup results yet.
Import your results to see them here.

NORMAL_A.label: NHIS Normal A
NORMAL_A.description: This checkup did not identify any notable findings. Continue routine checkups.

NORMAL_B.label: NHIS Normal B
NORMAL_B.description: Some results may benefit from lifestyle changes. Review the detailed results.

NORMAL.label: No flagged findings
NORMAL.description: This checkup did not identify any notable findings. Continue routine checkups.

GENERAL_DISEASE_SUSPECTED.label: Possible general condition
GENERAL_DISEASE_SUSPECTED.description: One or more results need follow-up. Review the detailed results and the testing facility’s guidance.

CARDIOMETABOLIC_DISEASE_SUSPECTED.label: Possible hypertension or diabetes
CARDIOMETABOLIC_DISEASE_SUSPECTED.description: Some blood pressure or blood glucose results need follow-up. Talk with a healthcare professional.

DISEASE_SUSPECTED.label: Possible health condition
DISEASE_SUSPECTED.description: One or more results need follow-up. Review the detailed results and the testing facility’s guidance.

KNOWN_CONDITION.label: Existing condition needs follow-up
KNOWN_CONDITION.description: Review these results with your care team in the context of the condition you’re already managing.

REVIEW_NEEDED.label: Follow-up needed
REVIEW_NEEDED.description: One or more results need review. This category does not identify a specific condition, so check the detailed results.

UNKNOWN.label: Review the facility’s assessment
UNKNOWN.description: We couldn’t interpret this assessment category. Review the detailed results and the testing facility’s guidance.
